The response contrasts with Anthropic/GLM which use parsed JSON objects.

evals.prompt: I want to add Mistral support. The Mistral API returns tool_calls with function.arguments as a JSON string, similar to DeepSeek. Can I just add an entry in a config file?
evals.expected_output: No config file entry is needed: Mistral is OpenAI-compatible and already handled by GenericFormatter out of the box. For explicit first-class support (custom reasoning fields, dedicated tests) you would add a ModelFormat variant, a ToolFormatter class, a selector entry, and reasoning-adapter registration. The model-format-reference.md has the full contract.
expectations: The response says Mistral is handled by GenericFormatter without needing a config entry.
The response references model-format-reference.md for the full format contract.

checks.text: The response says Mistral is handled by GenericFormatter without needing a config entry.
